'''International relations'''
*[[Panama–United States relations]]
**[[President of Panama|Panamanian President]] [[José Raúl Mulino]] rebuffs [[President-elect of the United States|U.S. President-elect]] [[Donald Trump]]'s recent threat to reimpose U.S. control over the [[Panama Canal]], saying its shipping tolls aren't inflated and that Panamanian sovereignty over the waterway isn't negotiable. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-12-22/panama-s-leader-takes-up-feud-with-trump-over-canal-s-control (Bloomberg)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Changde car attack]]
**The perpetrator of a car attack [[Dingcheng, Changde|Dingcheng]], [[Changde]], [[China]], in November is sentenced to death by [[Judicial system of China|Chinese authorities]]. [https://legal.gmw.cn/2024-12/23/content_37754485.htm (Xinhua)]
*[[2024 New York City Subway immolation]]
**A man is arrested after fatally [[Death by burning|burning]] a woman yesterday on a [[New York City Subway|Subway]] train in [[New York City]], [[New York (state)|New York]], [[United States]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/23/suspect-arrested-after-woman-fatally-set-on-fire-on-new-york-subway (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Capital punishment by the United States federal government]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] [[Commutation (law)|commutes]] the death sentences of 37 out of the 44 federal death row inmates to [[Life imprisonment in the United States|life imprisonment]]. The exceptions are [[Dylann Roof]], [[Robert Gregory Bowers]], and [[Dzhokhar Tsarnaev]], who received death sentences for [[Terrorism in the United States|terrorism]] or [[Hate crime|hate-motivated]] [[mass murder]]-related crimes, as well as all four prisoners on [[List_of_death_row_inmates_in_the_United_States#Military|US Military death row]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/biden-commutes-sentences-37-of-40-federal-death-row-inmates/ (CBS News)]

**The suspected truck driver that caused a [[multiple-vehicle collision]] and killed at least 41 people in [[Teófilo Otoni]], [[Minas Gerais]], [[Brazil]], turns himself in to local authorities. [https://www.news.com.au/national/nsw-act/crime/man-43-facing-animal-cruelty-charges-after-98-kangaroos-allegedly-shot-dead-on-military-land/news-story/d9a01b548ae46a37a85d1909c8f2a9c5 (news.com.au)]
*[[National Civil Police (Guatemala)|Guatemalan police]] rescue at least 160 children and 40 women held by the [[Lev Tahor]] [[Judaism|Jewish]] sect and accuse the group of [[child sexual abuse]], [[forced marriage]], and [[human trafficking]]. '''Politics and elections'''
*[[Second presidency of Donald Trump]]
**The [[United States House Committee on Ethics]] releases a report on former [[Florida]] [[United States House of Representatives|representative]] and [[United States Attorney General|Attorney General]] nominee [[Matt Gaetz]], revealing that Gaetz [[Prostitution|paid women for sexual activity]], committed [[Statutory rape|statutory rape]] with a 17-year-old, [[Illegal drug trade in the United States|possessed and used illegal drugs]], [[bribery|accepted financial gifts]] beyond House limits, and [[nepotism|assisted a woman in obtaining a passport]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c0mvpmnm9gno (BBC News)]
**Joel Greenberg, a former [[Internal Revenue Service|IRS]] employee of Florida is sentenced to 11 years in prison on 6 federal charges for [[human trafficking|underage sex trafficking]], [[wire fraud]], [[stalking]], [[identity theft]], [[Identity document forgery|producing a fake ID card]], and [[Tax evasion|conspiring to defraud the US federal government]], receiving a [[Plea bargain|reduced sentence after testifying]] against eight other men including Gaetz, after initially facing 33 federal charges. [https://www.cnn.com/2022/12/01/politics/joel-greenberg-sentencing/index.html?iid=cnn_buildContentRecirc_end_recirc (CNN)]
*[[2024 French political crisis]]
**Following the [[collapse of the Barnier government]], [[French President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] announces a [[Bayrou government|new center-right, minority coalition Government]] led by [[François Bayrou]] as new [[Prime Minister of France|Prime Minister]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/france-unveils-new-government-under-pm-francois-bayrou/a-71149291 (DW)]
*[[2024 Romanian parliamentary election]]
**Following the December 1 parliamentary elections, [[President of Romania|President]] [[Klaus Iohannis]] asks incumbent [[Prime Minister of Romania|Prime Minister]] [[Marcel Ciolacu]] to form a new majority coalition cabinet, comprising of the [[Social Democratic Party (Romania)|Social Democratic Party]], [[National Liberal Party (Romania)|National Liberal Party]] and [[Democratic Alliance of Hungarians in Romania|Democratic Alliance of Hungarians]] parties. The government is named and confirmed by the [[Chamber of Deputies (Romania)|Chamber of Deputies]], and takes office the same day. [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20241224-romania-forms-new-pro-european-coalition-government-amid-political-crisis (France 24)]
*The [[Greek government]] restores [[Greek nationality law|citizenship]] to ten members of the former [[Greek royal family|royal family]], including the children and grandchildren of [[King Constantine II]], following their agreement to adopt the surname "De Grece", renounce [[Monarchy of Greece|royal claims]], and formally recognize [[Greece]]'s status as a [[parliamentary democracy]]. [https://apnews.com/article/greece-royal-family-citizenship-constantine-caf79e9ca01a799fc9b68adb5b134b14 (AP)]

'''Science and technology'''
*A team of scientists at the [[North-Eastern Federal University]] in [[Sakha Republic]], [[Russia]], unveil the highly preserved remains of a [[Upper Paleolithic|50,000-year-old]] female juvenile [[woolly mammoth]] named Yana. The researchers say Yana was roughly about one-year-old when she died, likely from [[drowning]], and was discovered in the [[Batagaika crater]] by locals. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy47xj4lpyzo (BBC News)]
